description.text: Teaching Objective The Master’s Degree of Computer Science & Technology for foreign students is to train specialized personnel in engaging in Computer Science & Technology research and practice. Educational Requirements 1. Good moral qualities and the spirit of devoting, cooperating, developing and innovating; 2. A good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems; 3. A fairly good grasp of no less than one kind of foreign language Major Course Computer Network Database design Advanced Operating Systems Modern Software Engineering Advanced Computer Architecture Organizational Behavior, Modern Optimization Techniques Modeling and Simulation Nerual Network Techniques Object-Oriented Development Methods Mixed language program design ISDN and ATM Technology Advanced Computational Methods Programming the 80x86 Pentium-Based Personal Computer The Theoretics of Network Protocol Duration 2-3 academic years

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3750 USD/per year ￥ 27000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
